method: Headless Chromium from this research environment, 1280 by 900 window, locale en-CA, nothing typed or submitted and no account created; on Float's page the cookie banner was answered with Reject All so the form could be seen. Full screenshots kept privately; only the crops below are published.
note: Fresh captures for the Customer Journey examples (founder brief, 31 October 2026). They are dated separately from the 23 October observations and change no observation, status or finding. Loop's sign-up page returned a browser verification checkpoint to this environment on 31 October 2026, so no Loop capture was made.
